resources.string: For swipe tuning, record about 100–200 ordinary sentences while using both thumbs naturally. Include short and long words, punctuation, and varied tablet grips (held, on a table, and in split-screen if relevant). Avoid passwords, private messages, and other sensitive text: the trace contains the words you type. Recording stays on this device until you explicitly export it. Share the exported file only if you are comfortable sharing its contents. The normal Kinetica build records nothing.
